description: Land Acquisition - Bajankele, Kirinda-Puhulwella D/S Division, Matara District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2015/44 of 10.01.2019 Thihagoda D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and claimant information) for public purposes related to the Southern Express Way Project. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
